LENA VARGA-HOLM
Senior Data Engineer | Data Platform
lena.vargaholm@example.com | +385 55 555 0101 | github.com/lvh-data-example

PROFILE
Senior Data Engineer with 9 years of experience building and operating production data platforms and cloud data warehouses for e-commerce, logistics and payments. Experienced with Python, SQL, Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, AWS and Kafka across batch and streaming workloads. Focused on reusable platform capabilities, reliable data quality, clear data contracts and warehouse performance.

EXPERIENCE
Senior Data Engineer | Lukovac Freight Hub d.o.o. (logistics marketplace) | 03/2022–Present
- Own the ingestion and orchestration layer of the data platform, operating approximately 140 Airflow DAGs loading from Postgres, MySQL, Salesforce and third-party APIs into Snowflake.
- Migrated approximately 300 stored procedures into dbt; the warehouse now has more than 420 models with tests. Reduced the nightly build from 5 hours 10 minutes to 1 hour 35 minutes using incremental models and slim CI in GitHub Actions.
- Introduced JSON Schema data contracts and CI checks between product teams and the data team, reducing broken-pipeline incidents from approximately 9 to 2 per month.
- Designed and built a Kafka-based shipment-event pipeline processing approximately 30 million events per day, with end-to-end latency under 2 minutes at p95; added dead-letter and replay tooling.
- Replaced hourly full-table orders extracts with Debezium CDC into Kafka, reducing replica CPU during loads from approximately 70% to 25%.
- Reduced the Snowflake bill from approximately 38,000 to 24,000 per month in 2024 through warehouse sizing, auto-suspend and removal of unused tables.
- Mentor two mid-level data engineers, run weekly data platform office hours and participate in a one-week-in-six platform on-call rotation.

Data Engineer | Kovalent Pay (payments startup) | 09/2019–02/2022
- Built PySpark reconciliation jobs on AWS EMR processing approximately 1.2 TB of raw files from S3 daily; reduced finance team's manual month-end reconciliation from approximately 3 days to 4 hours.
- Designed a Redshift dimensional warehouse schema with more than 30 fact and dimension tables for finance and risk.
- Set up Great Expectations data quality checks on critical finance tables.
- Wrote a Python library for S3 and Glue Data Catalog access used by four teams.

Junior Data Engineer / BI Developer | Adria Retail Group | 06/2017–08/2019
- Maintained SSIS packages and T-SQL ETL into an on-premises SQL Server warehouse.
- Migrated 60 nightly SSIS jobs to Python scripts scheduled with cron.
- Built Power BI reports for store operations across more than 40 stores.

SKILLS
Programming: Python, SQL, Bash
Data platform: Airflow, dbt, Spark (PySpark), Kafka, Kafka Connect, Debezium, Snowflake, Redshift, PostgreSQL, Great Expectations
Cloud and infrastructure: AWS (S3, EMR, Glue, Lambda, IAM, MSK), Docker, Terraform (basic)
Engineering practices: Dimensional modelling, data contracts (JSON Schema), data quality testing, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), incremental models
BI: Power BI, Looker (basic)

CERTIFICATION
AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate | May 2024

EDUCATION
MSc Computer Science (Data Science track) | Northgate Technical University | 2017
Thesis: Incremental materialized views for analytical queries

OPEN-SOURCE AND COMMUNITY
Contributor to a community Airflow provider: fixed a pagination bug and added tests; two merged pull requests (2023).
Speaker at a regional data meetup (2024): "Data contracts without the hype."
Teach SQL for beginners at a local women-in-tech meetup, approximately four evenings per year since 2021.

LANGUAGES
Croatian (native), English (C1), German (B1)

Dear Halden Pay Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Senior Data Engineer – Data Platform role. Over nine years in data engineering, I have built and operated production data platforms for logistics, e-commerce and payments, with a focus on dependable pipelines, reusable capabilities and data that business teams can trust.

At Lukovac Freight Hub, I own the ingestion and orchestration layer, operating around 140 Airflow DAGs and a Snowflake warehouse with more than 420 dbt models. I migrated approximately 300 stored procedures into dbt, added tests and CI, and reduced the nightly build from 5 hours 10 minutes to 1 hour 35 minutes. I also introduced JSON Schema data contracts and CI checks that helped reduce broken-pipeline incidents from about nine to two per month. This work aligns closely with your focus on a shared platform and reusable frameworks.

I have also built streaming and batch systems at scale: a Kafka shipment-event pipeline processing around 30 million events per day, and PySpark reconciliation jobs on AWS EMR processing approximately 1.2 TB of daily files. The reconciliation work cut manual month-end effort from about three days to four hours. My experience includes AWS, Snowflake, Redshift, Python, SQL, Docker and GitHub Actions, as well as dimensional modelling, data quality testing and mentoring engineers.

I am interested in Halden Pay’s Data Platform role because it brings platform engineering together with the needs of analytics, data science and product teams. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience building reliable, reusable data systems could contribute to the team.

Kind regards,
Lena Varga-Holm
